title: Hunter Henry: It's good that the Super Bowl loss still stings

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Hunter Henry: It's good that the Super Bowl loss still stings
sources.description: The Mike Vrabel situation has dominated much of the attention being paid to the Patriots over the last few weeks, but tight end Hunter Henry said in a Tuesday press conference that the players have been focused on football while in the building for the last two weeks.
